_doc: Allow-list for checks/multipliers.mjs (T084, D-147, D-155). Each entry: file (glob), pattern (regex on the code line), source (public source with year, or why it is not a model value), decision (DECISIONS.md ID). status 'needs-source' marks values with no named public source yet: the check passes them with a WARN line so they stay visible; the human decides. Add entries rather than widening patterns.

entries.source: Empirical calibration to IRENA, Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025 (2026), fig. 2.8: new-build onshore CF, projects commissioned 2023-2025, 12 European countries (DEU ESP FRA SWE GBR POL ITA FIN GRC AUT BEL LTU); refit 0.8793 in T081 (report_t081.md). Stands in for unmodelled losses; physical loss model planned

Empirical calibration to IRENA, Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025 (2026), fig. 4.7: new-build offshore CF, projects commissioned 2024-2025 in China, Germany, France and the UK. Stands in for unmodelled losses; physical loss model planned

NONE NAMED: flat 12% wind losses (wake, availability, electrical) applied to Global Wind Atlas gross CF, a legacy convention with no public source in the repo; to be replaced by losses by technology (NEXT-WORK section 4: DEA, NREL ATB, Nygaard 2020, Akhtar 2021)
Bounds on the ERA5 speed scaling; where k would exceed 1.8, T081 quantile-maps ERA5 onto the GWA 4 Weibull distribution instead (Staffell and Pfenninger 2016, Energy, method)
T054 sensitivity script (not shipped): the same k bounds as build_wind_profiles.py
Cap on the solar calibration factor to the Global Solar Atlas (World Bank Group / Solargis) annual yield; disclosed limit

PVWatts-style DC (5%) and AC (1.5%) losses (Dobos 2014, NREL PVWatts v5 manual, model form); the level is then calibrated to the Global Solar Atlas, so these change only clipping (T066 contract section 1)
Conservative guard: IRENA, Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025, global offshore cost about 2.7x onshore; not applied where a regulator's capex is used (METI 2020, MOEA 2023)

Gulf and Central Asia capex proxy: mean of IRENA 2025 values for Egypt, Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan (RPGC 2025 fig. 2.4), among the largest buyers of Chinese wind turbines in 2024 (Chinese Wind Energy Association, 2025)
CRF(w,40)/CRF(w,30) for TSO-owned export links: 40-year regulated life (TenneT Net op zee; BNetzA section 17d EnWG); wind life 30 years (NREL ATB 2024; DEA Technology Catalogue)
Wind life 30 years (NREL ATB 2024; DEA Technology Catalogue), as app.js
Solar and battery local capex: Saudi Arabia's IRENA 2024 installed cost (Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025) used for the other Gulf states, as the app's methods state
Hatton et al. (2025), Scientific Data 12, 1912 (v3): median offshore minus onshore wind cost of capital, +0.92 points
Hamilton, Millstein, Bolinger, Wiser and Jeong (2020), Joule 4: 0.17%/yr for newer US wind plants
Wind life 30 years (NREL ATB 2024; DEA Technology Catalogue); IRENA's 25 years disclosed as a sensitivity
NONE NAMED in the repo: 0.5%/yr PV degradation (app default since before T024)
NONE NAMED in the repo: solar 30 and battery 20 years (app defaults, stated in the methods)
NONE NAMED in the repo: backup generator lives (diesel 20, OCGT 25 years); backup is off by default
Not a model value: the user's cost-sensitivity controls, default 1 (no scaling)
Not a model value: chart y-axis headroom
NONE NAMED in the repo: unsubsidised diesel price floor ($0.80/l) for the optional backup; off by default
Mirror of the app's diesel price floor (constants.js); backup off by default
NONE NAMED in the repo: transmission line life (50 years) for the LCOE view's transmission-cost reference mode
T061 check script (not shipped) against PBL Eindadvies basisbedragen SDE++ 2025: 25-year life (PBL), 0.2%/yr degradation (Hamilton et al. 2020)
T067 check script (not shipped): mirrors the app's solar defaults (ILR 1.3, opex 1.5%, life 30, degradation 0.5%/yr)
Mirror of app.js O&M defaults as a share of capex (battery 2%, onshore wind 2.5%, offshore 3.5%) for the add-on oracle; no public source named in the repo for these shares
Copy of app.js WIND_WACC_PREMIUM_DEFAULT: Hatton et al. (2025), Scientific Data 12, 1912 (v3), median offshore minus onshore wind cost of capital +0.92 points; onshore +0
Not a model value: a sort key that orders search results
Not a scaling: the even-spread threshold, a third of a year's output in four of twelve months (a definition, T077)

Not a model value: the population cartogram's drawing floor (minimum density, 5% of the mean) so near-empty land stays drawable; it changes no number in the article. The human accepted the map at 5% (5 Nov 2026).
